name: Home Services and Trades
bestFor: Plumbers, electricians, HVAC companies, roofers, painters, repair companies, and other local trades.
caution: Only display verified licensing, insurance, emergency availability, warranties, service areas, reviews, and response-time claims.

name: Cleaning Services
bestFor: Residential cleaning, commercial cleaning, move-out cleaning, janitorial, and specialty cleaning businesses.
caution: Do not claim fixed prices, background checks, green products, or satisfaction guarantees unless the client confirms them.

name: Landscaping
bestFor: Landscapers, lawn-care businesses, garden designers, hardscape companies, and outdoor-maintenance providers.
caution: Use real project images with approval. Do not promise plant survival, maintenance schedules, or warranties without clear client terms.

name: Professional Services
goal: Book a consultation or discovery call.
bestFor: Consultants, accountants, attorneys, financial professionals, business advisors, and B2B firms.
caution: Credentials, case-study outcomes, logos, financial statements, and legal claims must be accurate and approved.

name: Healthcare and Wellness
bestFor: Clinics, therapists, chiropractors, dentists, med spas, fitness studios, and wellness providers.
caution: Avoid outcome guarantees, inaccurate medical claims, and assumptions about insurance, emergency care, availability, or patient eligibility.

name: Restaurant and Café
goal: Drive visits, reservations, or food orders.
bestFor: Restaurants, cafés, bakeries, bars, food trucks, and catering businesses.
caution: Menu details, prices, allergens, hours, reservation links, and delivery options must be current and client-approved.

name: Salon and Beauty
bestFor: Hair salons, barbers, nail studios, estheticians, makeup artists, and beauty services.
caution: Use consented client photos. Do not promise results, claim availability, or publish pricing and cancellation policies without verification.

name: Real Estate
bestFor: Individual agents, brokerages, property managers, and real-estate teams.
caution: Listings, prices, availability, sales records, licenses, awards, and market claims must be up to date and permitted for publication.

name: Agency and Portfolio
bestFor: Creative agencies, web studios, photographers, freelancers, designers, and production companies.
caution: Only show work, logos, testimonials, results, and client names that the owner has permission to publish.

name: Ecommerce Lite
bestFor: Small product businesses, makers, specialty retail, and businesses using an external checkout or shop platform.
caution: Do not publish inaccurate prices, inventory, shipping times, returns, ingredients, safety information, or payment claims.
